objective: Share untrusted material selection intent across native desktop tabs within one verified account session; never grant material access.
interfaces: desktop:material-draft event {generation,revision,items}; no lease in event
boundaries: Only current native main-frame pages while Auth active; generation and short-lived session lease must match.
Verified scope and generation bind the session; temporary lock seals while preserving intent, confirmed retirement clears intent and rotates lease.
Only validated local project-relative asset references or cloud IDs are stored; no URL, credentials, media bytes or grant.
Concurrent edits use revision conflict; broadcast failure cannot silently overwrite.

tests.result: 74 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; synthetic accounts, actual extracted native main callbacks and isolated owned fixtures

limitations: Requires integration with the independently developed UI adapter and exact-commit non-author review.
Real Windows Electron cross-tab A/B, revocation and delayed IPC delivery remain unverified.
The draft is not a verified asset version, material permission, file locator capability or Fission input.
